segments.title: 3 more real AI fails
segments.say: Three more real AI fails, all on the record.

segments.title: 1. City bot: take their tips
segments.say: One: New York City's business chatbot said bosses could take workers' tips.

segments.title: Source: The Markup
bullets: Wrong on tips and cash rules
segments.say: The Markup caught it. The city took it down.

segments.title: 2. A bot roasted its boss
segments.say: Two: D P D's delivery chatbot swore at a customer and mocked the company.

segments.title: 3. A wrong fact in an ad
segments.say: Three: Google's first Bard ad got a telescope fact wrong.

segments.title: The fix
segments.say: The fix: check the source, and ask for a human when it matters.
